Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">POMPANO BEACH, Fla., Sept. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- BioStem Technologies, Inc. (Nasdaq: BSEM) (&#x201c;BioStem&#x201d; or the &#x201c;Company&#x201d;), a leading regenerative medicine company focused on the development, manufacturing, and commercialization of perinatal tissue allograft products, today announced it has entered into a $40 million Committed Equity Facility (the &#x201c;CEF&#x201d;) with Roth Principal Investments, LLC (&#x201c;Roth&#x201d;), an affiliate of CR Financial Holdings, Inc., the holding company for Roth Capital Partners.</font></p><p style="margin-left:3.04%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10.5pt;margin-top:10.1pt;font-family:Times New at BioStem&#x2019;s sole discretion by way of a private placement and subject to certain conditions set forth in the CEF common</font><font
